description: This file defines a command-line command 'TestHookCommand' using the Commander framework. It provides functionality to send a specified text to a configured hook, with an optional configuration file path. The command is set up with arguments, options, and an asynchronous run method that loads configuration, creates a hook executor, and executes the hook job.

classes.name: TestHookCommand
classes.description: A command-line command for invoking hooks with specified text, supporting configurable JSON file path.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously loads configuration, initializes a hook executor, runs the hook job with the specified text, and prints confirmation.
